messages.subject: Ecological Data Science Role
parts:
Hi y'all,
I am shamelessly using this list for advertising an industry role. I'm hiring a data scientist to join my team at Funga (https://www.funga.earth/), to support our work analyzing forest productivity and experimental data. This is a rare opportunity for an industry role in ecology. It's a fascinating ecological tech stack, and a fabulous group to work with.

https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/funga/jobs/5155669008

This is an onsite role in Austin, TX, USA. Please send the word!

Cheers,
Alison Ketz
